analysis:
All three changed files are test-only fixtures under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests. They are not shipped in the provider binary and add no production code paths.

SegmentedFleetGeometry.swift (head lines 96-98): only a doc comment changed. The description of maximumPrefillChunk now says it is max(plain chunk, solo stripe). The logic at head lines 99-103 is unchanged.

GPTOSSCheckpointRestartFixture.swift: adds a static sdkPrefillGeometry dictionary (head lines 17-20) built from CBv2SchedulerConfig() defaults. makeBridge gains an optional environment overrides parameter (head lines 206-216), merged into the environment passed to EngineV2Factory.makeProductionBuild. The default overrides are empty. The existing kill-switch logic is preserved: DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 is set when store is nil, but an explicit override would win. This is test-only and touches no production policy. The fixture still uses an ephemeral random key, a temp root and test identities. No change to the SSD tier's HMAC names, TTL, AAD or KEK handling (T-041) is visible.

Qwen35CheckpointRetentionFixture.swift (head lines ~235-240): the environment now also sets prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey from CBv2SchedulerConfig defaults, alongside the solo stripe. Only test geometry and scheduling are affected. Prefill chunk sizing is not a trust boundary or a confidentiality control here.

No change to the coordinator-provider wire contract, attestation, App Attest authorization, key custody or cache-scope derivation. No secrets are introduced. I did not review the production EngineV2Factory code that consumes these environment keys; it was not supplied. A production regression there would belong to a different PR.
